ocr.markdown:
Here's what's cookin': Taco Dish Dip
Recipe from the kitchen of: Mom      Serves: Cake pan
1st layer
1# hamb. Brown w salt+pepper + onion
Add: 1 can refried beans
1/2 jar med. or hot taco sauce      (put over hamb)
2nd layer
Mix together: 1 c. sour cream
1/2 c. real mayonaise
1 envelope taco seasoning mix
3rd layer
grated cheese, onions,
black olives
Dip w round tortilla chips
